description: This file is a shell script (wwan.sh) that initializes and manages WWAN (Wireless Wide Area Network) modem connections. It sources other protocol scripts, and defines functions for setup, teardown, and configuration of wireless WAN interfaces, including handling USB devices and vendor/product identification.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Function stub for setting up MBIM protocol, reports missing protocol.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Function stub for setting up QMI protocol, reports missing protocol.

methods.name: proto_ncm_setup
methods.description: Function stub for setting up NCM protocol, reports missing protocol.

methods.name: proto_3g_setup
methods.description: Function stub for setting up 3G protocol, reports missing protocol.

methods.name: proto_directip_setup
methods.description: Function stub for setting up direct IP protocol, reports missing protocol.

methods.name: proto_wwan_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the WWAN protocol configuration, adding string parameters such as apn, auth, username, etc.

methods.name: proto_wwan_setup
methods.description: Sets up the WWAN interface by detecting USB devices, resolving device nodes, determining driver type, and invoking the appropriate protocol setup.

methods.name: proto_wwan_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the WWAN interface based on stored driver and device info, invoking protocol-specific teardown functions.
